articles.title: From DQ to European Record: Sara Curtis Stuns at Sette Colli Trophy
articles.summary: After a morning disqualification was overturned, Italian teenager Sara Curtis shattered the European record in the 50m backstroke with a 27.07. She's now #2 in the world this season. The meet saw several top seeds miss finals, setting up thrilling underdog battles.

articles.title: Eufy's Floodlight Cam Hits Record Low Price—Here's Why It's a Game-Changer
articles.summary: The Eufy E340 floodlight camera, with dual lenses, 2,000-lumen lights, and local recording, is cheaper than ever. It can identify faces 50 feet away and track subjects automatically—no subscription needed. A rare Prime Day steal for home security.

articles.title: Poll: Pan Pacs Expected to Be Speed Central of 2026 Swimming Season
articles.summary: In a SwimSwam poll, 59.8% of voters picked the Pan Pacific Championships as the meet likely to produce the most fastest winning times. The women's field is stacked with stars like Summer McIntosh, while the men's side is more spread across Europe and Asia.
